texts.preamble: Daya Kishan Sharma And Others vs Union Of India And Others on 13 July, 2017 Author: Amol Rattan Singh Bench: Amol Rattan Singh Cwp No. 7044 of 2017 (O&M) 1 In The High Court Of Punjab & Haryana At Chandigarh. Cwp No. 7044 of 2017 (O&M) Date of decision:13.7.2017 Daya Kishan Sharma and others ... Petitioners versus Union of India and others ... Respondents Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Amol Rattan Singh. Amol Rattan Singh, J. (Oral)
texts.arguments: Mr.Rajiv Atma Ram, learned Senior counsel appearing for the petitioners, submits that this petition may be disposed of in terms of what has been stated by respondent no.3, i.e. the State of Haryana, in its short reply, to the effect that the new service rules have been drafted, by which the Food Safety Officers, i.e. the petitioners, and others similarly placed, would be provided a promotional avenue as Designated Officers under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Mr.Rajiv Atma Ram, learned Senior counsel appearing for the petitioners, submits that this petition may be disposed of in terms of what has been stated by respondent no.3, i.e. the State of Haryana, in its short reply, to the effect that the new service rules have been drafted, by which the Food Safety Officers, i.e. the petitioners, and others similarly placed, would be provided a promotional avenue as Designated Officers under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
